mapper.select: SELECT step_detail_id AS detailId, treat_plan_id AS planId, treat_step_id AS stepId, type, tooth_bit AS toothBit, billing_item_id AS billingItemId, billing_item_name AS billingItemName, unit, price, quantity, status, remark FROM treat_plan_detail_history tpdl INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(crt_time) AS crt_time, step_detail_id FROM treat_plan_detail_history WHERE AND status < #{status} AND treat_plan_id = #{planId} GROUP BY step_detail_id ) tpdl2 ON tpdl.step_detail_id = tpdl2.step_detail_id AND tpdl.crt_time = tpdl2.crt_time
